HediffDef.label: life drained
HediffDef.description: This pawn has had a large part of its vitality stripped away by Wraith feeding. The visible condition fades as the immediate shock passes, but the biological aging caused by the feeding is permanent.

HediffDef.label: fed recently
HediffDef.description: This Wraith has fed recently. Its regenerative tissues are saturated with stolen vitality and repair injuries much more rapidly for roughly one RimWorld day.
